paragraphs.text: 1. THE sacrifice drawn out with threads on every side, stretched by a hundred sacred ministers and one,-
This do these Fathers weave who hitherward are come: they sit beside the warp and cry, Weave forth, weave back.
paragraphs.original: इमे वयन्ति पितरो य आययुः प्र वयाप वयेत्यासते तते
paragraphs.translit: ime vayanti pitaro ya āyayuḥ pra vayāpa vayetyāsate tate

paragraphs.text: 2. The Man extends it and the Man unbinds it: even to this vault of heaven hath he outspun, it.
paragraphs.original: पुमाँ एनं तनुत उत्कृणत्ति पुमान्वि तत्ने अधि नाके अस्मिन् ।
paragraphs.translit: pumām̐ enaṃ tanuta utkṛṇatti pumānvi tatne adhi nāke asmin |

paragraphs.text: These pegs are fastened to the seat of worship: they made the Sama-hymns their weaving shuttles.
paragraphs.original: इमे मयूखा उप सेदुरू सदः सामानि चक्रुस्तसराण्योतवे
paragraphs.translit: ime mayūkhā upa sedurū sadaḥ sāmāni cakrustasarāṇyotave

paragraphs.text: 3. What were the rule, the order and the model? What were the wooden fender and the butter?
paragraphs.original: कासीत्प्रमा प्रतिमा किं निदानमाज्यं किमासीत्परिधिः क आसीत् ।
paragraphs.translit: kāsītpramā pratimā kiṃ nidānamājyaṃ kimāsītparidhiḥ ka āsīt |

paragraphs.text: What were the hymn, the chant, the recitation, when to the God all Deities paid worship?
paragraphs.original: छन्दः किमासीत्प्रउगं किमुक्थं यद्देवा देवमयजन्त विश्वे
paragraphs.translit: chandaḥ kimāsītpraugaṃ kimukthaṃ yaddevā devamayajanta viśve

paragraphs.text: 4. Closely was Gayatri conjoined with Agni, and closely Savitar combined with Usnih.
Brilliant with Ukthas, Soma joined Anustup: Brhaspati's voice by Brhati was aided.
5. Viraj adhered to Varuna and Mitra: here Tristup day by day was Indra's portion.
Jagati entered all the Gods together: so by this knowledge men were raised to Rsis.
paragraphs.original: विश्वान्देवाञ्जगत्या विवेश तेन चाकॢप्र ऋषयो मनुष्याः
paragraphs.translit: viśvāndevāñjagatyā viveśa tena cākḷpra ṛṣayo manuṣyāḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. So by this knowledge men were raised to Rsis, when ancient sacrifice sprang up, our Fathers.
paragraphs.original: चाकॢप्रे तेन ऋषयो मनुष्या यज्ञे जाते पितरो नः पुराणे ।
paragraphs.translit: cākḷpre tena ṛṣayo manuṣyā yajñe jāte pitaro naḥ purāṇe |

paragraphs.text: With the mind's eye I think that I behold them who first performed this sacrificial worship.
paragraphs.original: पश्यन्मन्ये मनसा चक्षसा तान्य इमं यज्ञमयजन्त पूर्वे
paragraphs.translit: paśyanmanye manasā cakṣasā tānya imaṃ yajñamayajanta pūrve

paragraphs.text: 7. They who were versed in ritual and metre, in hymns and rules, were the Seven Godlike Rsis.
paragraphs.original: सहस्तोमाः सहछन्दस आवृतः सहप्रमा ऋषयः सप्त दैव्याः ।
paragraphs.translit: sahastomāḥ sahachandasa āvṛtaḥ sahapramā ṛṣayaḥ sapta daivyāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Viewing the path of those of old, the sages have taken up the reins like chariot-drivers.
paragraphs.original: पूर्वेषां पन्थामनुदृश्य धीरा अन्वालेभिरे रथ्यो न रश्मीन्
paragraphs.translit: pūrveṣāṃ panthāmanudṛśya dhīrā anvālebhire rathyo na raśmīn
